name: Neapolitan Pizza Dough
desc: Four-ingredient Neapolitan dough mixed by hand and fermented a full day at room temperature, for six 10-inch pizzas.

source.title: Authentic Neapolitan Pizza Dough Recipe
source.evidence: Identical gram formula (922 g tipo 00, 553 ml water, 23 g fine sea salt, 1 g fresh yeast), the same salt-first, 10 percent batter, then yeast mixing order, and 250 g balls in a proofing box.

ingredients.raw: 1 g fresh yeast (or 0.3 g active dry yeast)
Tipo 00 or semolina flour, for the proofing box and shaping

steps: Pour the water into a large mixing bowl and stir in the salt until dissolved.
Add about 10 percent of the flour (roughly 90 g) and mix with your hand or a wooden spoon until smooth and batter-like.
Add the yeast and stir until dissolved. Adding it after the batter keeps it out of direct contact with the concentrated salt.
Add the rest of the flour gradually, mixing until it all comes together into one shaggy mass.

Turn the dough onto the counter and knead by hand 15-20 min (or 10-15 min on low in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic; a small piece should stretch thin enough to see light through without tearing.
Cover and rest 15-30 min, then fold the dough over itself a few times into a smooth round.
Bulk ferment: put it in an airtight container or a bowl covered with plastic wrap and leave at cool room temperature about 14 hours.

Divide into six 250 g pieces and shape each into a tight, smooth ball. Set them in a lightly floured proofing box (or individual lidded containers) and let rise another 10 hours, until soft and puffy.
Preheat: a wood-fired or outdoor pizza oven to about 850°F on the floor, or a home oven at its highest setting with a pizza stone or steel inside for at least 1 hour.

Set a ball in a little flour and press from the center outward with your fingertips, leaving a 1/2-inch rim for the crust, then stretch by hand to 10-11 inches. Do not use a rolling pin; it presses out the gas that makes the rim puff.

Top lightly and bake 60-90 seconds in a pizza oven, turning for an even bake, or 4-8 min on the stone or steel in a home oven (switch to the broiler partway if you have one), until the rim is puffed and spotted with char.
tips: The earlier version of this card bulk fermented about 2 hours and gave the balls the remaining 22 hours; the creator splits it 14 hours bulk and 10 hours in balls. Both run about 24 hours total at cool room temperature.
In a warm kitchen the dough will overproof on this schedule; use the cooler water and a cooler spot, or cut the bulk time.

references.title: Authentic Neapolitan Pizza Dough Recipe
references.usedFor: 14 plus 10 hour fermentation split, knead times, dry yeast equivalent, oven temperatures, stretch size, bake times
